{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.92

|gr1= Waypoints

|descr= Returns player's custom waypoint ({{Controls|LShift|LMB}}) position.

|s1= [[customWaypointPosition]]

|r1= [[Position]] as [x,y,0], or empty array [] if the waypoint does not exist

|x1= <sqf>
if (customWaypointPosition isNotEqualTo []) then
{
	hint format ["You are %1m away from your custom waypoint.", round (player distance customWaypointPosition)];
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[allMapMarkers]]
}}
